summary: Invest Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company trading OTC as IVCBF, filed an 8-K reporting that holders of roughly 99% of voting shares approved a charter amendment at a September 24, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, extending the deadline to complete an initial business combination from December 17, 2027 to December 17, 2029. The Extension passed with 10,625,000 votes in favor (about 99.76% of outstanding ordinary shares) and none against; no proxy solicitation occurred, with an Information Statement furnished under Section 14(c). Charter Amendment text is filed as Exhibit 3.1. Watch for trust-depletion, redemption and liquidation risk given the two-year runway extension.
